title: Generating sets for maximal orders in rational quaternion algebras
summary: Given a maximal order $\mathfrak{O}$ in a rational definite quaternion algebra, and a prime $\ell$ coprime to the discriminant of $\mathfrak{O}$, this paper considers subsets of $\mathfrak{O}$ consisting of elements with $\ell$-power norms that together generate $\mathfrak{O}$ as a $\mathbb{Z}$-algebra. We prove two theorems about the existence of such sets: the first states that $\mathfrak{O}$ is generated by elements of norm $\ell^k$ for any $k$ larger than an explicit bound, and the second states that there is a generating set for $\mathfrak{O}$ consisting of at most three elements, each…
